days.title: Glacial Peaks and High Roads
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Großglockner
stops.detail: It is located at the foot of the Grossglockner in the upper valley floor of the Möll Valley (Pasterzenboden) and is the source area of the Möll.

stops.name: Johannisberg
stops.detail: The highest point is formed by the 3453 m above sea level Johannisberg.

stops.name: Hohe Riffl
stops.detail: In the area of the Pasterze are located, among others, the mountain peaks Johannisberg, Hoher, Mittlerer and Kleiner Burgstall, Hohe Riffl, Schattseitköpfl and Vorderer Bärenkopf.

stops.name: Stausee Margaritze
stops.detail: The water of the Pasterze feeds the Margaritze reservoir, which lies below the Glocknerhaus.
